initialFocusedRoutingFailure.cause: The synthetic output passage was shorter than the existing 50-character extraction threshold.
initialFocusedRoutingFailure.resolution: Made the fixture passage long enough to exercise the intended acquisition path; retained the assertion of two local batches and one retrieval.

properties: A topical or output-only hit cannot satisfy every source-specific criterion.
Criterion pair identities distinguish different requirements for one evidence/obligation tuple; ambiguous legacy tuples cannot approve them.
Generated compound criteria are split only using literal human questions; model/parent-artifact text cannot become a human requirement.
Unprovided parenthesized AI examples are removed; human examples, parenthesized lists and decimal values are preserved.
A compiled graph consumes remaining local input evidence before another search; settled pairs are reused and unknown requests remain blocked.
Old records keep their old criteria, request keys and topical relevance behavior; no publication or scientific claim is approved by acquisition coverage.
boundary: Offline integration and saved-real-input replay, not new provider quality or independent acceptance. Original source/identity/budget guards remain required.
